scope_declarations.statement: Public product identity is deep matching between solo entrepreneurs and micro-business, starting geography Zurich. The 12-life-spheres framing is retired as public identity and retained as archived origin.
scope_declarations.defect: README.md at repository root still declares 'Android app for 12 life sphere MatchMaking'

scope_declarations.statement: Client-facing Synera is one product (deep matching). Anything running behind it creates no obligation, data flow or cost attributed to the client surface, and the boundary is declared explicitly rather than implied.

adp_requirements.requirement: Match depth: rank expected mutual value of a specific exchange, not only mode eligibility
adp_requirements.acceptance: Ranking explainable per pair from named inputs; unknown utility stays UNKNOWN, never becomes 0 and never auto-excludes a person; no ranking by general person quality.

adp_requirements.requirement: Reciprocity observation to surface one-sided takers, as pair state rather than person rating
adp_requirements.acceptance: Asymmetry computed over completed cases of a specific pair; surfaced as state of that relationship, never a global score attached to a profile; no reply and missing evidence are never penalised.
adp_requirements.resolution: Conservative edge utility min(u_ab,u_ba) already sanctioned in MATH.uk.md does not hide a one-sided zero; reputation attaches to the pair and case, not the person.

adp_requirements.requirement: Progressive per-user interface adaptation accumulating slowly over days
adp_requirements.acceptance: Every adaptation is reversible by the user in one action, inspectable on demand, and bounded to presentation only: information architecture and control meaning never change; agreed case material is never re-presented in a way that shifts meaning.

adp_requirements.requirement: Context adaptation for canton, language, locality, weather and holidays
adp_requirements.acceptance: Context inputs affect meeting logistics and language/copy only; they do not enter eligibility or ranking without a separately declared decision; weather and holiday data are advisory and create no obligation.

adp_requirements.requirement: Declared telemetry substrate feeding ADP-01, ADP-02 and ADP-03
adp_requirements.acceptance: Declared event schema with a named purpose per event; nothing collected without a named use; retention and export governed by P10; no exact coordinates or case material in telemetry; no second durable store.
adp_requirements.open_decision: High telemetry versus data minimisation cannot be resolved by engineering default. Recommended split: product-event telemetry yes, human-behaviour telemetry no.

adp_requirements.acceptance: Level 1 runtime configuration and presentation allowed within ADP-03; level 2 proposing schema/code/flow change with explanation and diff allowed; level 3 autonomous merge, deploy or change of agreed case material forbidden. Every autonomous change versioned, attributed and revertible; a change touching agreed content resets both acceptances; untrusted profile text never authorises an action.

adp_requirements.requirement: Product surface driven by versioned configuration so market re-shaping is a config revision, not a rewrite
adp_requirements.acceptance: Modes, fields, copy and flow steps are versioned configuration; migration invariants of P15 hold, old exports round-trip, permissions and deletions preserved; no second durable store introduced by the configuration mechanism.
adp_requirements.why_now: Architectural constraint, cheap if accepted before implementation, close to unpayable if retrofitted.

contract.central_rule: A case pins the config version it was agreed under; agreed cases keep rendering and exporting under that pin whatever the surface does next.
open_preconditions: store and Data API mapping needs source review
authority to raise a config version belongs to V6-05
transactional version-raise plus case pin is the same compare-and-set as V6-03
retention policy for live config versions undefined
classification of hint copy inside an agreed field needs legal review once E1-E5 unpark

adp_requirements.requirement: Single optimisation substrate connecting the two formalisations already present in the repository
adp_requirements.acceptance: One objective function with an explicit decision on which of min(u_ab,u_ba) or M_ij = S_ij - C_ij governs pair selection; the two are not equivalent and are not merged silently; self-tuning only over measured inputs; unmeasured parameters stay UNKNOWN; decorative or quantum formulations excluded until a task-shaped measurable gain exists.
adp_requirements.prior_decision_quoted: MATH.uk.md: quantum mechanics, resonance and decorative formulas are not evidence of effectiveness and do not enter implementation without a task-shaped gain
adp_requirements.why_now: No invention required; connect two existing documents and choose one of two formulas.

contract.decision: min(u_ab,u_ba) governs pair selection; the additive form is rejected because it selects one-sided pairs. Lambda moves from the vertex term to the edge term; per-person capacity is V6-10, not a new constraint.
contract.objective: max sum_e w_e x_e, w_e = min(u_ab,u_ba)*2^(-age/half_life) - lambda_e, s.t. sum_{e incident v} x_e <= cap_v, only ELIGIBLE_SCORED edges enter
contract.structural_finding: b_i = 0 in the product reading because a participant alone produces no collaboration; therefore the lambda/b regime table from ki-math-extract.md does not transfer, although its pair-beats-singles criterion does (verified on 20000 instances).

adp_requirements.acceptance: Work outside the client surface creates no obligation, data flow or cost attributed to the client product; the boundary is written down; no internal system reaches case material without the same consent required of an external one.

sequencing.rule: ADP-02, ADP-03 and ADP-05 all read the same thing: a trustworthy record of who agreed to what. That record is P03 and P04, both PLANNED_NOT_ACCEPTED with an open persistence defect at web_app:233-334. Adaptation trained on unreliable consent data is worse than no adaptation.
order: P03 and P04 accepted via V6-03 contract then V6-04 and V6-05
ADP-07 and ADP-08 now, as architectural constraint and document connection
ADP-01 and ADP-04 after a working matcher
ADP-05 only after an explicit owner decision on the P10/P15 collision
ADP-02 and ADP-03 last, when there is something reliable to measure
ADP-06 and ADP-09 are standing declarations with no separate cost

defects_found.statement: MODERN_SOURCE hashes in CONTEXT.json were computed on a CRLF (Windows) checkout. The repository stores LF, so recomputing them on Linux, macOS or GitHub yields a mismatch that looks like source divergence but is not.
defects_found.evidence: legacy_map recorded 0fc27900ec1abd87110f02f0cb80df5b00de00e9a65bc9df54aa7fef76fa6de1; as checked out (LF) 964fc638345cb7e8...; the same bytes forced to CRLF reproduce the recorded hash exactly. Same result for legacy_map_widget: recorded 77183a8df78c9427..., LF 35af7e0e81d6b495..., CRLF matches.
defects_found.consequence: The package's credibility rests on hash verification; a hash that only reproduces on one operating system will read as divergence to the next executor. Commit 37cee3f already fixed this class of problem for root files via .gitattributes, but only for those.
defects_found.fix: Record LF-normalised hashes for MODERN_SOURCE entries, or state the CRLF normalisation explicitly next to them
